title: BoundingDocs: a Unified Dataset for Document Question Answering with Spatial Annotations

bias_targets.methodology: An ablation study comparing model performance across four conditions (Template-Template, Template-Rephrased, Rephrased-Template, Rephrased-Rephrased) to measure whether models overfit to simplistic, repetitive question templates and to evaluate their adaptability to natural, human-written linguistic diversity.
